segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, this is Grant at Northfield Supply. We need to add 8 seats to our account before our training next Wednesday. Just want to make sure they show up today and we know the prorated charge.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can take care of that. Can you confirm the workspace name and the billing email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Workspace is Northfield Operations, and billing email is ap@northfieldsupply.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect, I have it pulled up in the admin console. You're currently on 42 seats at $36 per seat monthly, renewing on September 1. Adding 8 seats today brings you to 50 seats, and the prorated charge for the rest of the cycle is $76.80 before tax. Does that look okay?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, the seats are added. The billing tool generated invoice 48219 for $81.41 with tax, and it'll go to the card ending in 2246 on file. You should also get a receipt at ap@northfieldsupply.com in a few minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. And our admin can invite the new users right away?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, right away. I also refreshed the seat count in the admin console, so when your admin goes to Users, they'll see 8 available invitations.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, that's all I needed. Thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome. I'll note this under ticket 317684. Have a good one.
